title: National University of Modern Languages Amendment Ordinance 2011

sections.shortTitle: National University of Modern Languages Amendment Ordinance 2011
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE I OF 2011
ORDINANCE I OF 2011
NATIONAL UNIVERSITY
OF MODERN LANGUAGES
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2011
An Ordinance to amend the National
University
of
Modern Languages Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
14th March, 2011]
No.F.2(I)/2011-Pub, dated 14-3-2011.---The following
Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby published for general
information:---
Whereas, it is expedient to amend the National
University of Modern Languages Ordinance, 2000 (XVIII of 2000), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the Senate and the National Assembly are
not in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by
clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of
Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the following
Ordinance:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called
the National University of Modern Languages (Amendment) Ordinance, 2011.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
